rationale: The buyer is a professional Salesforce developer or admin at a company — a real B2B persona with budget — experiencing silent data corruption in production, which is a legitimate pain. However, the problem is highly niche (specific to AI-assisted sf CLI deployments) and buildability is constrained: a useful linting/diff tool requires deep Salesforce API integration and knowledge of deployment metadata side-effects, not just a Claude prompt + landing page. Operational autonomy is limited because validating deployment previews likely requires per-run API calls against live Salesforce orgs, and support questions will be complex. Signal strength is weak (single forum post), so this needs validation before any build investment.
solution_plan: WHAT: A pre-deployment diff checker that flags potential data-layer side-effects (like LastViewedDate wipes) before an sf CLI deployment runs. BUILD: The factory can build a lightweight web form where developers paste their deployment manifest or changeset; Claude analyzes it against a knowledge base of known Salesforce deployment side-effects and outputs a risk report — paired with a Stripe subscription link at ~$29/mo. SELL: Target Salesforce developer communities (Salesforce Stack Exchange, Trailblazer Community, relevant LinkedIn groups and Slack workspaces) with a cold outreach sequence the factory drafts and queues for your approval. MAINTAIN: Delivery is automated (form → Claude analysis → email report), billing via Stripe, and routine support handled by Claude; the only recurring human touch is approving outreach batches. CAUTION: The knowledge base of side-effects needs ongoing curation as Salesforce evolves — this is a real maintenance burden. Validate demand with 20+ outreach messages before building.
notes: operational_autonomy (5) and buildability_with_ai (5) both fall below build_gate floors (7 and 6 respectively). Stage capped at validate.
